title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། དབུ་མ། ར (Derge Tengyur, vol. 104)
shelf_note: Canonical Tibetan Buddhist commentary belonging to the Madhyamaka section of the Derge Tengyur.

pages.prefer_reason: Translation A cleanly preserves the commentary's lemma-exegesis structure with distinct paragraph breaks, avoiding intrusive extraneous commentary notes.

book_verdict: Flawless OCR transcription and faithful English translations of a classical Derge Tengyur Madhyamaka commentary folio.
